shadcn.note: Tokamak design rules: wiki docs/design. Tokens: @tokamak/ui/theme.css.

shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.message: "{{className}}" is an arbitrary value. Use the scale: spacing 1 2 3 4 6 8 12 16 (4 to 64 px), radius rounded-xs, sm, md, lg (4 to 16 px), text roles text-read, text-row, text-label, text-data, and the colour tokens in @tokamak/ui/theme.css.

shadcn/no-unknown-classes.message: "{{className}}" does not exist in the Tokamak theme. {{suggestions}} Spacing steps are 1 2 3 4 6 8 12 16, radii xs sm md lg, text roles read row label data, and shadow-raised is the only shadow.

message.spacing: <{{component}}> owns its padding. Use a size ({{sizes|none defined}}), or {{around}}.
message.default: <{{component}}> owns its look; only layout classes (margin, width, flex and grid placement) may be added. Use a variant ({{variants|none defined}}) or build your own element from tokens.
